newsitem.title: USA: Bayer says FDA committees see aspirin.
newsitem.headline: Bayer says FDA committees see aspirin.

text.p: Bayer Corp said Friday two Food and Drug Administration advisory committees have confirmed aspirin's value in heart attack and stroke prevention.
The company said the FDA indicated that it would broaden aspirin's approved indications and begin encouraging its use to prevent strokes in certain female patients who have had minor strokes.
In a release, Bayer said the committee concluded that aspirin could affect the treatment of peripheral vascular disease but believed the evidence was insufficient to warrant specific recommendations.
Since the 1980s, aspirin's use in stroke prevention has been acknowledged in men only, the company said.
